basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old space enthusiast living in the beautiful Annapolis Valley. By day, I work as a mechanical engineer at a local firm, and by night, I'm often found stargazing or tinkering with my telescope. I have a keen interest in aerospace technology and often dream of witnessing a SpaceX launch in person. Aside from my love for space, I enjoy grilling and experimenting with new recipes on my Grilla Grill. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time hiking the trails around the valley or diving into historical documentaries. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My engineering background and personal passion for space exploration have led me to self-teach a lot about aerospace technology. I often read articles and watch videos about the latest advancements in the field. My interest in history, particularly military and aerospace history, is fueled by documentaries and books.
